title: Fix two-camera playback and investigate image quality
goal: Restore recorded Franka camera playback and remove identified avoidable image quality loss without changing hardware control.
doneWhen: Configured camera recordings resolve to playable media
Image pipeline losses are identified and bounded improvements tested
decisions: User authorized playback and image-quality fixes; do not start hardware or overwrite recordings

verification.summary: Dynamic recorded-role playback verified against actual two-camera recording in an isolated browser UI; bounded capture/encoding improvements verified offline.
checks: 95 unittest cases: 92 pass, 3 SciPy skips; 16 backend tests pass separately in control environment
Actual global/wrist MP4 browser decoding: readyState=4, 640x480, duration=14.733333s, advancing playback and nonblack frame pixels
Synthetic JPEG80/default H264 versus JPEG95/CRF18: PSNR 24.92 to 26.26 dB; sample MP4 63790 to 80560 bytes
Mock camera mode/JPEG quality and encoder argument regression tests
limitations: Production workbench not restarted; changes take effect at next safe restart
No live camera or robot test; requested stereo mode/fresh recording cadence and perceived sharpness need operator confirmation
Isolated playback-only server omitted arm model/API routes; those 404s do not establish a production viewer failure
Original recordings cannot recover detail lost during capture and were not modified
